message: CONTENT-1-2 does not define the provider contracts needed to implement fake-HTTP-compatible canvas calls: allowed canvases.edit operation names and fields, canvases.sections.lookup request/response shape, bounded canvas export endpoint/response, or how free_team_canvas_tab_already_exists identifies the existing bound canvas; installed @slack/web-api has no canvas method/types. Provide the pinned API fixtures/contracts or revise the task before implementation.

notes:
Authoritative Slack contracts (fetched from docs.slack.dev today; cite in code comments):
canvases.edit: POST; args token, canvas_id, changes[]; ONE operation per call. Change: {operation: insert_after|insert_before|insert_at_start|insert_at_end|replace|delete|rename, document_content?: {type:'markdown', markdown} (content ops), section_id? (REQUIRED for insert_after/insert_before/delete; optional for replace=whole-doc when absent), title_content? (rename only)}. Key errors: canvas_editing_locked (surface as retryable), canvas_not_found, canvas_too_large, missing_scope, free_teams_cannot_edit_standalone_canvases.
canvases.sections.lookup: args canvas_id, criteria {section_types?: ['h1'|'h2'|'h3'|'any_header'], contains_text?}; response {ok, sections:[{id}]} — IDs ONLY, no text (why READ cannot fall back here).
canvases.create: args title?, document_content {type:'markdown', markdown}, channel_id (REQUIRED for free teams; we ALWAYS pass the host-derived channel per plan); response {ok, canvas_id} ONLY — permalink comes from a follow-up files.info(file: canvas_id) (canvases are files), non-fatal on failure. Errors: free_team_canvas_tab_already_exists (return the channel's existing canvas: conversations.info -> properties.canvas file id; if that shape differs empirically, surface the error with guidance instead — implement defensively behind a helper), canvas_creation_failed, canvas_disabled_user_team, missing_scope.
Canvas READ/export: no dedicated endpoint — canvases surface as files; fetch the file's url_private with bearer auth and treat the body as text; this is UNVERIFIED live (scope gap) — implement behind the runtime missing_scope/error gate with honest errors per prior resolution. The installed SDK lacking canvas methods is expected: use direct HTTPS calls (slack.com/api/...) via the adapter's existing HTTP helper patterns, matching how file-delivery.ts calls files.getUploadURLExternal. Proceed.

message: CONTENT-1-2 does not specify the canvas_update operation enum or how to resolve the existing channel-bound canvas after free_team_canvas_tab_already_exists; both affect the public MCP schema and Slack request flow.

notes: Specs: (1) canvas_update public schema: {section_handle?: string, operation: 'insert_at_start'|'insert_at_end'|'insert_before'|'insert_after'|'replace_section'|'delete_section'|'replace_all', markdown?: string, confirm_replace_all?: boolean}. Mapping: replace_section->Slack replace WITH section_id; replace_all->replace WITHOUT section_id and REQUIRES confirm_replace_all:true (else error listing current section handles from a fresh lookup — that is the plan's destructive-gate); delete_section->delete (section_id required); inserts map 1:1 (before/after require section_handle). markdown required for all but delete_section. rename is NOT exposed in v1. (2) free_team_canvas_tab_already_exists: resolve the existing channel canvas via conversations.info(channel) -> channel.properties.canvas.file_id; if that field is absent, return an honest error ('channel already has a canvas but it could not be resolved; open it in Slack') — implement behind a small helper so the shape assumption is one place.
